objective: Combine the counts of completed tool inspections across unequal workshops, compare item weighting with an equal-workshop average, and explain why the recorded difference is not a causal workshop effect.

sources.text: Fictional inspection log: North workshop inspected 30 tools, of which 18 passed the checklist. Both workshops used the same checklist and counted a pass only if every item was complete by Friday at 16:00.
South workshop inspected 70 tools; 14 passed the checklist by the common deadline.

Each tool has a unique inventory identifier and was inspected once at exactly one workshop. No tool occurs in both workshop lists. North received newer tools and South received older tools; the logs do not establish why pass rates differed.
